name: codex
description: Codex and official Google Antigravity ACP agents as native Claude Code background subagents; Codex full access, Antigravity workspace permission approvals, session-isolated persistence.

agyPath.title: Antigravity binary
agyPath.description: Optional absolute path to Google's official agy CLI >= 1.5.1. Blank discovers PATH, common Unix install directories and the official Windows install directory. Run agy yourself to sign in and turn Use AI Credits off in /settings.

codexPath.title: Codex binary
codexPath.description: Optional Codex CLI override (needs app-server --listen). Leave blank for auto-discovery. Windows searches native PATH executables, npm packages, Desktop CLI installs and the Store package; missing overrides fall back automatically.

nodePath.title: Node binary
nodePath.description: Node 18+ used to run the bridge process. Blank or missing paths fall back to common Homebrew/system Node locations, then `node` on PATH. Custom version-manager installations may need an absolute path.

defaultEffort.title: Default effort
defaultEffort.description: Codex reasoning effort for every model when the prompt sets no effort: header line. per-model: each model's own default, luna max and sol, astra and terra high.
